label: docs
file: README.md

The "Running locally" section tells readers to run `npm run serve`, but package.json defines no `serve` script (only `start`, `build`, `test`, and `lint`). The closest equivalent is `npm run build` followed by `npm start`, which runs `node dist/index.js`. The README should be updated to reference the actual script name(s) instead of `serve`.
